scoring_justification: Result-level comparison of reported values against paper gold; recompute from raw DFT logs is infeasible in the verifier sandbox.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for clustered magnetic moments and spin multiplicities
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text and Table S1: neutral UAu6 ground state is quintet, magnetic moment 4 μB (3 μB on U + ~1 μB on X atoms); anionic ground state is quartet, magnetic moment 3 μB.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's reported results.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are explicitly stated in the paper.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for pristine UAu4 monolayer quantities
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Lattice constant and bond length from Table 2 (a=4.70 Å, U-Au=3.11 Å). Magnetic moment 2.08 μB (with SOC) from text. MAE 5.49 meV/atom from text. ΔE_ex = -109.68 meV and J = -6.85 meV/unit cell from Table 3 (with SOC).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Copied from the paper's tables and text.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: All numbers are directly reported in the paper.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for hydrogenated UAu4H4 monolayer exchange parameters
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Supporting Information Table S7 and main text: fully hydrogenated leads to FM with J ~ 5.0 meV/unit cell (positive) and ΔE_ex = 20.0 meV.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper's supporting information and the positive J required for Curie temperature ~210 K.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Derived from the paper's reported transition to FM and consistent with Curie temperature estimate.

hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: 'Curie temperatures of both monolayers are calculated to be ~210 K'.

outputs.description: Spin multiplicities and total magnetic moments for neutral and anionic UAu6 clusters.
Lattice constant, bond length, magnetic moment, MAE, exchange energy difference, and exchange coupling constant for pristine UAu4 monolayer.
Exchange energy difference and exchange coupling constant for fully hydrogenated UAu4H4 monolayer.
Curie temperature of the ferromagnetic UAu4H4 phase estimated from Monte Carlo simulation.

output_contract.notes: All values are compared to hidden paper-reported reference values with appropriate tolerances. Spin multiplicities are expected to be exact.
